title: Number Word Matching Worksheets for Kindergarten – Free Printable
intro: Keep the math accessible while introducing number words.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Read the number words aloud and match each to a numeral and a small collection. Let the student draw the connecting lines.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Try one match together: place five counters beside a card showing 5. Count the counters, say “five,” and show a second card with the word five. Explain that both cards name the same number.

Move the word card to a new position and ask the child to find it again. The match depends on the number name, not on which cards happen to be across from one another.

Ask your student

Which numeral shows the same amount as this word?

If your student needs help

If reading gets in the way, say the word without giving away its matching numeral.
